Service

Crocodile & Snake Awareness Training

Onsite training, toolbox talks and site briefings that keep crews croc-wise and snake-safe.

Most wildlife incidents are avoidable. Our awareness training gives workers the knowledge to recognise crocodile and snake risk, change how they work around water and bush, and respond correctly if something goes wrong — delivered onsite, in plain language, by people who work with these animals every day.

What’s included

  • Crocodile biology, behaviour and habitat — where and when the risk is highest
  • Safe work practices near water: distances, boat and vehicle use, camp siting
  • Snake identification, avoidance and what to do in an encounter
  • Snakebite first-aid awareness and emergency response planning
  • Toolbox talks and site inductions tailored to your project
  • Attendance records for your training register

When you need it

Site inductions for new crews and contractors

Before works start near water or in crocodile habitat

Wet-season refreshers when conditions change

Any organisation whose people work where crocodiles and venomous snakes may be present

How it works

  1. 1Know the animal

    Crocodile and snake behaviour and habitat.

  2. 2Read the site

    Where and when the risk is highest.

  3. 3Work safely

    Distances, boats, vehicles and camps.

  4. 4Respond

    Encounters, first-aid awareness, emergencies.

Questions

How long is a session?

Anything from a toolbox talk or safety briefing to a site-specific presentation or comprehensive awareness course — tailored to your operational environment, workforce experience and risk profile.

Do you come to our site?

Yes. Training is delivered onsite so it can reflect the real conditions your crew works in.

Is training enough on its own?

Training is a key control, but on high-risk water sites it works best alongside overwatch and good work-practice controls.
